goals: Verify the application's main page renders with the correct title.
Verify the application can retrieve and validate the versions of Heroic, Legendary, and GOGDL components.
activities: Verify the page title is 'Heroic Games Launcher'.
Retrieve the Heroic version using the application API.
Assert that the Heroic version is '2.6.3' or newer.
Retrieve and process the Legendary version string using the application API.
Assert that the Legendary version is '0.20.32' or newer.
Retrieve the GOGDL version using the application API.
Assert that the GOGDL version is '0.7.1' or newer.
